calls.exactPrompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: one opaque square game effect picture, STONE_SPE resource 42 / item 0 / picture 0, to replace a complete logical 64 by 64 pixel native window. Make one original high resolution PNG illustration, preferably square 1280 by 1280. It is NOT a sprite sheet, icon, standalone cutout, poster or portrait.
Reference roles: Image 1 is the exact original 64x64 native bitmap of this specific picture 0, PRIMARY authority for every object, placement, pose and silhouette. Image 2 is the same packed bits freshly drawn at eight pixels per original bit, PRIMARY readable geometry reference; black/white squares are diagnostic encoding, not a request for pixel art. Image 3 is an accepted game material/palette reference ONLY: restrained hand-painted realism, charcoal green and aged bronze. Do not copy its border, empty background layout or ornamental motifs.
Primary request: faithfully reinterpret the entire native picture 0 as a detailed painted historical game animation frame. Keep the one small helmeted human figure in the center-left among the dense irregular stone forms. Preserve the figure's head position, facial direction and bent/occluded body silhouette as shown in picture 0. Preserve the long pale diagonal implement/shape on the right, angled from lower-left toward upper-right exactly like the original silhouette; keep its scale and endpoints. Do not replace an ambiguous native implement with a bow, spear, firearm or exaggerated fantasy weapon. Preserve the dense clustered stones behind the figure across the upper left, upper middle and right, and the diagonally arranged foreground forms crossing the lower picture. The native bitmap alone determines occlusion and all scene content.
Composition: match Image 2 over the full square from edge to edge, including its narrow clear strip across the very top and stone masses at the edges. One person only; the body remains partly hidden by the same foreground forms. Do not zoom into a portrait, pull objects apart, add a second person, or invent visible lower limbs where the native stones conceal them. Readable small-scale silhouette takes precedence over decorative detail.
Style: restrained realistic hand-painted Three Kingdoms game art, subtly textured cool gray stones, charcoal green recesses, muted aged bronze on existing clothing/equipment details. Natural soft directional light, no fiery glow, no colored magic, no dramatic cinematic location. The entire 64x64 logical scene is opaque; a quiet dark charcoal-green ground fills all gaps.
Constraints: opaque PNG with NO alpha transparency; single complete frame; no text, digits, damage numbers, UI, glyphs, labels, title, border, extra logo, watermark, invented troops, scenery, flags, mounts, ships, flames or effect trails. Preserve picture 0 geometry rather than drawing a generic stone spell. No black-and-white pixel-grid look in the final painted image.
